title: What If You Tried to Sink in the Dead Sea?

scenes.text: What if you tried to sink in the Dead Sea? You can't. And it isn't magic.
The water is about thirty-four percent salt. That's roughly nine or ten times saltier than the ocean.
All that salt makes it denser than your body. About one point two four kilograms per liter, so you bob like a cork.
Nothing bigger than microbes lives in it. Only a few algae and salt-loving archaea survive in the water.
It sits on the lowest dry land on Earth, about four hundred and forty meters below sea level, and the lake keeps dropping about a meter a year.
So you can't sink here. The Dead Sea itself is the thing that's sinking.

description:
What if you tried to sink in the Dead Sea?
The water is about 34 percent salt and denser than your body, so you float. Meanwhile the lake itself keeps dropping about a meter a year.
